purpose: Immutable freeze of original parent acceptance contract without scope reduction

requirements.text: Establish Issue #8 as a machine-readable Agent Context Registry, with permanent comment IDs, a compact JSON table of contents, a versioned schema, and clear authoritative-source references.

criteria.text: Registry bootstrap resolves a permanent Issue #8 TOC and all referenced sections by exact comment ID, version, and schema without relying on comment position.
Readback checks confirm JSON validity, unique stable references, ownership, and links to Issues #1/#2/#3/#6/#7/#13.
Any reuse of existing Issue #8 content preserves original history and follows the change review process.

requirements.text: Construct an evidence-backed executable architecture graph for IssueStack: components, actions, workflows, GitHub Issues, state stores, schemas, event triggers, data flow, ownership, and dependency edges.

criteria.text: Graph nodes/edges use defined types, stable IDs, provenance, source commit SHA and observed/unknown distinctions.
Representative intake→validation→queue→scratchpad→execution→review→completion path can be traversed from graph with source evidence.
Graph audits dangling edges, duplicated identities, missing ownership, stale commits, and unsupported behavioral claims.

requirements.text: Create a source-intelligence catalog of actual repository scripts, workflow YAML, schemas and configuration with interfaces, triggers, side effects, tests and canonical immutable source references, without indiscriminately copying whole files.

criteria.text: Inventory relevant JS, YAML/YML, JSON, schema/config and other discovered executable artifacts with canonical paths, ref/commit SHA, content hash where available, authorship and inventory coverage.
Index exports/functions, workflows/events, state ownership, dependencies, consumers, effects, linked tests, and gaps as verified findings or unknown.
Canonical repository objects remain authoritative; include compact excerpts only when materially useful and avoid duplicate full-source archives.

requirements.text: Maintain an independently verified operational-state view distinguishing documented, implemented, tested, currently working, degraded, failed, stale and unknown status per subsystem.

criteria.text: Each state assertion links to timestamped workflow run, test receipt, job record, artifact or other independently retrievable evidence, with freshness rules.
Dashboard/JSON distinguishes submitted vs transferred vs executed vs completed vs archived; unresolved/untested status is explicitly unknown.
At least one real end-to-end path is tested or clearly reported blocked with exact missing evidence.

requirements.text: Capture architectural decision memory and cross-repository evolution for IssueStack, CommandLine, StateMachines, and other actually verified related predecessors or dependents.

criteria.text: Decision records contain motivation, constraints, alternatives, rejected approaches, tradeoffs, status and source links, and do not invent author intent.
Repository relationship edges identify verified origin, supersession, remaining dependencies and compatibility without assuming all prior mechanisms remain active.
Unsupported relationships are labeled hypotheses, not facts.

requirements.text: Create a versioned catalog of operational invariants, failure modes, negative cases, and recovery procedures grounded in reproducible evidence.

criteria.text: Invariants include nonce identity, event ordering/ordinal behavior where relevant, idempotent transfer, stable comment IDs, source ownership, state transitions, receipts, and review gates.
Failures link to specific tests, errors, incidents or minimal reproducible counterexamples; mitigations identify validation and recovery checks.
Known failure modes and unresolved ambiguities are queryable by component and severity.

requirements.text: Provide contextualization retrieval interfaces for cold-start agents using a concise bootstrap, task-specific lookup keys, bounded context budgets, and selectively expanded source/evidence references.

criteria.text: A cold-start agent can retrieve essential architecture, relevant file/function, live state, and procedural rules via indexed comment IDs without fetching all 13 issues.
Retrieval records specify scope, schema version, evidence quality, dependencies, timestamp and what must be reverified before mutation.
Authoritative README/AGENTS and Issue #6 task instructions retain priority; registry summaries are not substitutes for mandatory reads.

requirements.text: Implement source-driven refresh, observed-runtime refresh, integrity checks, change detection and stale-context warnings with bounded, idempotent updates.

criteria.text: Changes to indexed files or documented schedules update only affected entries and manifest version, with tests for no-op/idempotency and eventual consistency.
Static source discovery and runtime observation are separate and reconcile source hash, commit, trigger, run IDs and timestamps.
Failure to refresh cannot silently present stale data as current; expose drift or unknown with actionable recovery and protect against edit loops.

requirements.text: Build an automated contextualization evaluation harness comparing cold-start agents with baseline repository documentation versus with the registry, using verified question-answer and diagnostic-task fixtures.

criteria.text: Fixtures include intake transfer, duplicate prevention, source-to-scratchpad mapping, execution receipts, workflow ownership, current health and failure recovery; each fixture has evidence-backed ground truth and explicit unanswerable cases.

Report factual accuracy, unsupported assertions, relevant retrieval count, token consumption, context staleness, completion success and uncertainty calibration, with repeatable runs/seeds and configurable scoring weights.
Include a held-out or adversarial validation set and a regression threshold configurable without modifying core logic; record benchmark artifacts and limits.

requirements.text: Expose documented, editable configuration and evaluation surfaces for coverage, index depth, freshness limits, retrieval priorities/token budgets, benchmark weights and thresholds, and allowed repositories.

criteria.text: Versioned config schema, valid defaults, validation errors and example overrides can be inspected and updated without editing core analyzer logic.
Automated tests demonstrate two materially different supported configurations, including lower context budget and stricter freshness policy.
Measurements and evaluation criteria are inspectable, exportable and tied to configured versions.

requirements.text: Enforce access and change-review controls, and prove the registry works with reproducible tests and published evidence before declaring the job complete.

criteria.text: Never copy secrets, credentials, private chain-of-thought, private repository content without authorization, or other sensitive material into public Issues; protect untrusted comments and preserve source-of-truth precedence.

Follow Issue #1→#2→#3 handshake, authorized workflow/file-write routes, config/file-metadata.json updates for substantive file edits, and per-change approval/revert review with byte-exact baseline and manifest.

Run schema and integrity validations, graph/link consistency checks, source indexing, refresh/drift tests, task-specific retrieval, operational observation and benchmark; record passes/failures, references and execution receipts in the mapped job and scratchpad.

constraints.text: Do not replace source files with copied code in GitHub comments; source files and immutable commits remain canonical.
Keep the Issue #8 context registry grounded, versioned, provenance-tagged, and explicit about unknown or stale findings.
Keep changes authorized within BestNameYet/IssueStack-; other repositories may be read where permitted but require separate authorization for mutation.
Preserve existing IssueStack intake/transfer/scratchpad/review/agent-instruction procedures; no policy bypass, undocumented state mutation, or unverifiable success.
constraints.source: IssueStack current AGENTS.md and task instruction library

constraints.text: Audit and update config/file-metadata.json for substantive repository file changes if it exists and is applicable; distinguish planned changes from authorized committed changes.

invariants: Every original requirement and criterion remains authoritative and retains its verbatim text.
A failed or unverified original criterion cannot be redefined as passed by downstream procedure, documentation, or changed wording.
Each criterion requires independent acceptance evidence, not merely a source edit or a passing schema validation.
A pending publication approval cannot be used to defer feasible semantic computation; compute proposals first and review publication separately.
Packets execute strictly P001 through P057 with verified predecessor receipt and total-token budget under 10,000.

states.pass: Criterion independently verified by actual evidence and acceptance test
states.partial: Some but not all of criterion independently verified
states.fail: Observed counterexample or acceptance test failure
states.unknown: Missing or stale independent evidence; no affirmative assertion

evidence.observation: Original R1–R11 text preserved at P001 compilation
P001 pre-change handshake and planned files verified
